_help: Mission template. Replace the values, delete the blocks you don't need (only 'title' and 'platforms' matter), then Save.
Easiest route: give this template, missions/README.md and your data files' names + date ranges to an AI and ask it to write the mission.
'file' is the filename of a .nc already added to Glider Playground. Dates are naive UTC. 'offset' is [right, down] in pixels.
